recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast night scene on a city street featuring a five-member band in 1970s glam attire. The composition uses long-exposure light trails from passing cars to create horizontal motion, contrasted against a static, brightly lit rectangular marquee sign in the upper right. The lighting is a mix of cool street lamps and warm incandescent glows from buildings.
coreVisualRelationships: Static human subjects against dynamic light-trail background
Warm yellow marquee glow vs. cool blue-toned street lighting
Vertical band members breaking the horizontal flow of the street
High-sheen fabric textures (velvet, satin) reflecting urban light
coreInvariants: A prominent rectangular yellow sign as the primary light source
Urban sidewalk setting with visible street furniture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged in a loose 'V' formation; three standing in the mid-ground, two seated in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, glowing yellow rectangular sign in the top right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright top-right sign, follows the standing figures down to the seated foreground figures, then sweeps left along the light trails.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured asphalt and night sky provide breathing room around the central cluster of figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays of the night street and asphalt.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white from the illuminated signs and light trails.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated jewel tones (ruby red, sapphire blue) in the band's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing signs and the dark shadows; high saturation in the clothing highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon pinks or greens; stick to warm incandescent yellows and cool mercury-vapor blues.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a 45-degree slanted, connected script with heavy chrome-like beveling.
Secondary text uses a condensed, all-caps sans-serif mimicking theater marquee letters.
Script features long, sweeping descenders and a shooting star motif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final 's' in the script extends into a stylized five-pointed star with motion lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A flamboyant, beveled script for the main identity paired with a rigid, utilitarian sans-serif for location/date details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the marquee secondary text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A night street scene on Sunset Blvd in 1975. Long exposure showing white and red car light trails. Five men in glam rock attire (velvet jackets, satin shirts, flared pants) posed on the sidewalk. A large glowing yellow rectangular sign is blank in the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a beveled chrome script logo tilted at 15 degrees inside the yellow sign area. Add a smaller white marquee sign in the background with red block lettering.

verificationChecks: Is the main text tilted and beveled?
Is the fashion period-accurate to the mid-70s?
Is the primary light source a yellow rectangle?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the main logo tilt
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the light trails do not obscure the subjects' faces.
Check that the chrome effect on the text looks metallic rather than plastic.
Verify the yellow sign is the brightest element in the composition.
Confirm the clothing textures (velvet/satin) are visually distinct.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [70s urban night photography] with [long exposure light trails] and [beveled chrome script typography] inside a [glowing yellow marquee box].
